title: Deprecated Assets and Archive Hygiene
outOfScope: Deleting any asset, archived Contract, Summary, Event, Manifest, or release evidence.
Cleaning the execution plan documents reserved for WI-18.
Provider, adopter, production, Japanese capability, and release publication changes.
Rewriting unrelated scripts or changing runtime behavior without registry evidence.

sources.reason: WI-13 scope, acceptance, and prohibition on premature WI-18 cleanup.
Archive index and preserved evidence inventory.
Archived Contract/Summary pairs and manifest-backed lifecycle evidence.
Current archive, lifecycle, and governance check entry points.
Repository script inventory for registry reference validation.

riskAssessment.reason: Registry and validation changes must preserve immutable evidence and fail closed on incomplete deprecation records.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution; this Work Item is bounded to registry, validation, and documentation evidence without deletion.

preReviewWarnings: Review that registry completeness does not authorize deletion.
Review archive integrity and recovery paths before any future cleanup Work Item.

intent.problem: The repository has accumulated historical assets and archive evidence, but deprecation intent, replacement, retention, and recovery boundaries are not represented by one executable registry.
constraints: Do not delete or rewrite archived evidence.
Do not perform WI-18 plan-document cleanup early.
Use deterministic local checks and preserve external-control boundaries.
intent.rationale: A registry and fail-closed validator make future cleanup reviewable while preserving the evidence required for lifecycle audit.

rawUserRequest: Execute the approved AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation plan serially. For WI-13, establish deprecated asset and archive hygiene evidence without deleting protected records, complete the full Work Item/PR/merge/close workflow, record issues, and align documentation before WI-14.

declaredIntent.summary: Create executable deprecated-asset registry and archive-preservation boundaries without deletion.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Complete registry entries pass deterministic validation.
Incomplete or stale registry entries fail closed.
Protected archive evidence is never classified as deletable.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A Deprecated Asset Registry records id, path, type, replacement, deprecatedSince, plannedRemoval, reason, currentReferences, runtimeUsed, and migrationRequired.
A deterministic checker fails closed on missing fields, invalid dates, missing replacements, stale planned removal dates, and references to protected archive evidence.
Negative and positive tests cover registry schema, reference integrity, protected evidence, and recovery/deletion boundary semantics.
Deprecated asset documentation and the checks catalog explain that this Work Item records and validates candidates; it does not delete protected evidence or perform WI-18 plan cleanup.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Preserve immutable Contract/Summary/Event/Manifest/release evidence and fail closed before deletion.
Do not claim archive cleanup merely from registry validation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Explicit user authorization to execute the approved remediation plan and update governed registry/evidence paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
